app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns FotMob's current match-to-audio-language availability index. Match ids are open-ended and can be passed to /fotmob/match. The list is independent of a selected match date and may include matches outside the current fixtures feed.
Returns every ranking period currently offered by FotMob for the selected gender. Use a returned periodId with /fotmob/fifa-rankings.
Returns ranked national-team points and rank changes for one period. Discover valid periodId values for the selected gender from /fotmob/fifa-ranking-periods.

parameters.description: Period id returned for this gender by /fotmob/fifa-ranking-periods
parameters.name: period_id

get.description: Returns the global English latest-news feed. Items are article previews; the upstream response contains up to 20 items per offset. Use start_index increments of 20 to page without overlap.

Returns FotMob's public league page payload, including available tabs, overview, table, fixtures, statistics, transfers, and seasons where supplied by the league. Discover valid season values with /fotmob/seasons. shotmap=true includes the optional, larger overview shot-map payload.

parameters.description: Optional season value from /fotmob/seasons for this league
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Include the optional overview shot map; increases response size
parameters.name: shotmap

get.description: Returns FotMob's full public league directory grouped into popular, international, and country collections. Use league ids with other FotMob endpoints.

Returns public metadata for 1 to 11 selected lineup players. Player ids are open-ended and can be discovered through /fotmob/search or /fotmob/lineup-builder-team. Unknown ids without complete public metadata return 404.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of 1 to 11 numeric FotMob player ids
parameters.name: player_ids

get.description: Returns the public lineup builder's prefilled formation, starting lineup, and squad for a team id. Discover open-ended team ids with /fotmob/search. Some teams legitimately have no squad list.

parameters.description: Numeric FotMob team id discoverable through /fotmob/search
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns FotMob's public match-details payload, including available facts, events, statistics, lineups, shot map, momentum, table and head-to-head sections. The data field preserves the upstream JSON shape; individual sections may be absent for a match.
Returns the public highlight-video and media metadata for one match. The request uses FotMob's English United States variant; unavailable media is represented by null source fields.

parameters.description: Numeric FotMob match id, discoverable from /fotmob/matches or /fotmob/search
parameters.name: id

get.summary: FotMob match videos and media metadata

get.description: Returns FotMob's public match payload for a calendar date and IANA timezone. The data field preserves the upstream JSON shape.
Returns a page of FotMob news items for one league. League ids are discoverable from /fotmob/leagues; start_index is a zero-based offset.

Returns the full article body for a FotMob-authored top-news story. Pass the complete id-and-slug value from the public /topnews/<id> URL. News previews from external publishers remain external and are not fetched.

parameters.description: Complete FotMob top-news article id and slug from the public article URL
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns a public FotMob player profile, including current team, injuries, recent matches, career history, trophies, market values, and the player-specific season identifiers needed for deeper statistics. Discover player ids through /fotmob/search. Market values are included by default.

parameters.description: Numeric FotMob player id from fotmob/search
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Include market-value history; defaults to true
parameters.name: include_market_values

get.description: Returns the public per-match stat rows for one player, including the available stat key, value, and translated label. Discover player ids through fotmob/search and match ids through fotmob/match or fotmob/player-matches.

Returns one page of player match history. The player's matchFilters and permitted league/team pairs are discovered from /fotmob/player. For another page, copy the numeric before timestamp from the upstream previous URL.

parameters.description: Numeric FotMob player id from fotmob/search
parameters.name: player_id

parameters.description: all, or a numeric league id from fotmob/player matchFilters
parameters.name: league_id

parameters.description: all, or a numeric team id paired with league_id in fotmob/player matchFilters
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.description: Numeric before timestamp from the upstream previous URL; omit for the newest page
parameters.name: before

get.description: Returns deep statistics, shot map, heatmap, and goalkeeper shot map for one player-specific season entry. Discover valid season_id values and hasDeepStats from /fotmob/player statSeasons; entry ids vary by player and season.

parameters.description: Numeric FotMob player id from fotmob/search
parameters.name: player_id

get.description: Returns public search suggestions for FotMob leagues, teams, players, and matches. term must contain 1 to 50 characters. Suggestions preserve the upstream JSON shape.
Returns the complete list of season values accepted by the FotMob league endpoint for one competition.

Returns ranked player or team statistics for a stat id discovered from /fotmob/stats-categories. The accepted stat ids vary by league, season, and type. team_id optionally restricts player statistics to one team. position filters player results client-side.

parameters.description: Numeric season id from /fotmob/stats-categories; defaults to the newest season
parameters.name: season_id

parameters.description: Stat id returned by /fotmob/stats-categories for this league, season, and type
parameters.name: stat

parameters.description: Optional numeric team id to filter player stats
parameters.name: team_id

get.summary: FotMob league player or team statistics

get.description: Returns FotMob's current stat catalog and available seasons for a league. With season_id omitted, the response exposes the season list and initial top-stat choices; pass a returned season id to retrieve that season's full player or team stat catalog.

parameters.description: Numeric season id; omit to discover seasons
parameters.name: season_id

get.summary: FotMob league stat categories and seasons

get.description: Returns the league standings and the upstream table views, including all, home, away, form, and expected-goals tables. League ids are discoverable from /fotmob/leagues.

Returns public team data and the sections currently available for that team, such as overview, table, fixtures, squad, stats, transfers, and history. Team ids can be found with /fotmob/search. The upstream section set varies by team. For older fixtures, pass fixtures.previousFixturesUrl to /fotmob/team-fixtures.

Returns one page of older team matches. Start with the fixtures.previousFixturesUrl cursor from /fotmob/team, then pass each response's previous value as cursor until it is empty or null. Team ids are open-ended numeric ids discoverable through /fotmob/search.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor copied from fixtures.previousFixturesUrl in /fotmob/team or previous in the preceding response
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Returns the paginated article feed shown on a public FotMob team news page. Team ids can be found with /fotmob/search or /fotmob/team.

Returns confirmed transfers, rumours, or popular transfers with the public transfer-center filters. Fee values are in EUR. Use fotmob/leagues and fotmob/search to discover league and team ids. The upstream returns 50 rows per page and caps its hit count at 10,000.

parameters.description: One-based result page; 50 rows per page
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Transfer direction; applied when league_ids or team_ids is supplied
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Comma-separated numeric FotMob league ids, up to 50; discover with /fotmob/leagues
parameters.name: league_ids

parameters.description: Comma-separated numeric FotMob team ids, up to 50; discover with /fotmob/search
parameters.name: team_ids

parameters.description: Return only likely rumours; mode must be rumours
parameters.name: likely_only

get.description: Returns the five-story Trending shelf shown on FotMob's public News page. Items are curated previews and may overlap the global latest-news feed; the upstream list is dynamic. No locale or country parameter is exposed because the complete accepted value space is not pinned.

Returns FotMob's current grouped trending suggestions for all entities, players, teams, and leagues. The feed is dynamic and may vary by the upstream's inferred region; no region or category parameter is exposed.
Returns the public seven-day football broadcast schedule for a country, with local schedule times. Discover all accepted country codes from /fotmob/tv-guide-countries. Timezone defaults to UTC.
Discovers channels attached to matches in the selected country's current seven-day public TV guide window. Use the country directory to discover the complete country code set.
Lists all country codes exposed by FotMob's public football TV guide country selector.
